cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! I'll coordinate the responses. I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, management is arranging its day around me. I'll follow whatever reporting times keep your investigation running smoothly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My influence reaches laundry now. I'll share their desk at their quiet times and use your reply format. Put the complaints in the order you need; I'll run a correspondence operation that touches every guest.

reason: Make A cooperate with investigation times, workspace sharing and reply requirements while celebrating each restriction as expanding influence.
